profile.name: Vijaykumar Karthikeyan
profile.title: Bioengineer · Developer · Researcher
profile.bio:
Hi, I'm Vijay — I work at the intersection of biology and computation. I build CRISPR diagnostics, ML-powered biotech tools, and products that turn lab insights into real-world impact.

Currently a Bioengineering undergrad at UCLA (CS technical breadth + Data Science Engineering minor). Always happy to chat about science, building, or soccer.

experiences.title: Student Researcher @ The Kamariza Lab
experiences.description: CRISPR/Cas13 nucleic acid diagnostics under Dr. Mireille Kamariza. Building platforms to design in vitro CRISPR assays for infectious disease detection without noncanonical activation.
achievements: Studying mechanisms and activation of CRISPR/Cas13 for nucleic acid diagnostics
Engineering platforms to design in vitro CRISPR assays for infectious disease detection

experiences.title: Kinetiq — Smart Knee Brace
experiences.description: Lead fullstack developer for a smart knee brace recovery platform: React web app, Swift iOS app, and Django REST backend on AWS. Tracks recovery analytics from sensor data for clinicians and patients.
achievements: Published iOS application on the App Store
Presented research at the 2nd Annual Arizona Digital Health Symposium

experiences.title: Cofounder and CTO
experiences.description: Biotech startup incubated in Founders, Inc. and backed by Startup UCLA. Led technology for an AI-powered cloud platform that helps biotech and pharma researchers analyze biological images.
achievements: Incubated in Founders, Inc. and backed by Startup UCLA
Launched an AI-powered cloud platform for biological image analysis

experiences.title: Paper-Based CRISPR-Cas13a RNA Diagnostic for Tuberculosis
experiences.description: Engineered a paper-based CRISPR-Cas13a diagnostic strip for point-of-care Mycobacterium tuberculosis RNA detection via fluorescent readout. Optimized a two-stage assay protocol using BSA passivation and trehalose stabilization.
achievements: Point-of-care paper strip for TB RNA detection with fluorescent readout
Optimized assay with BSA passivation and trehalose stabilization

experiences.title: Polaris — Agentic Hospital Paging System
experiences.description: AI agent paging system that alerts clinicians — built with Next.js and FastAPI. Won Best Social Impact Award at LA Hacks 2026.
achievements: Best Social Impact Award at LA Hacks 2026
Created an AI paging system that alerts clinicians
